title: Analista de Ressarcimento Sênior
description:
A J&T Express é conhecida como uma das maiores empresas do setor de transportes de logística, entrega expressa, armazenamento e cadeia de suprimentos. Estamos presentes em 13 países, como Indonésia, Vietnã, Malásia, Filipinas, Tailândia, Cambodja , Singapura, China, Arábia Saudita, Emirados Árabes Unidos, México e Brasil. Nossos serviços alcançam mais de 2 bilhões de pessoas ao redor do mundo.

Todos os dias fornecemos aos nossos clientes uma experiência de entrega expressa de excelente qualidade e eficiência, altamente confiável, trazendo mais benefícios às pessoas e fazendo com que elas aproveitem as transformações da economia digital. Nossos números:240 centros de transferências de larga escala;1.000 equipamentos de triagem inteligente;23.000 pontos de distribuição;400.000 colaboradores; nossos serviços atingem 2,5 bilhões de pessoas ao redor do mundo. Venha construir um futuro melhor conosco!

Posição: Analista de Ressarcimento Sênior

Descrição da posição:

  • Atuar com o fluxo de ressarcimento dos clientes;
  • Mapear e acompanhar o ressarcimento das filiais e KA Performar análises de performance dos clientes designados (atividade secundária);
  • Criar relatórios em Excel sob demanda dos clientes e gestão;
  • Análise de BI e de operação sob demanda;
  • Atuar no cumprimento das metas de qualidade e operação, prestando suporte e demandando das áreas responsáveis;
  • Identificar falhas processuais e ajudar com as suas correções, com planos de ação.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ter experiência em posições similares, de preferência na área logística.
  • Necessário conhecimento ou experiência com ressarcimento e indenização.
  • Excel intermediário ou avançado (será testado).
  • Inglês avançado será considerado diferencial.
  • Vivência com Power BI será considerado diferencial.

local de trabalho: Bairro Jardim Belval / Barueri - 100% presencial

Contrato: CLT

Benefícios

  • Refeitório
  • VA
  • VT
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Assistência Médica
  • Plano Odontológico
  • Totalpass
  • Convênio Farmácia
  • PLR

Todas as nossas vagas são abertas para pessoas de diferentes gêneros, raças, etnias, orientações sexuais, identidades de gênero, idades, pessoas com deficiência e demais grupos diversos.

Acreditamos na diversidade como um valor e promovemos um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo, respeitoso e com oportunidades equitativas para todas as pessoas.

title: Torneiro CNC
description:
Descrição da Empresa

A Usinagem JJ atua há mais de 30 anos no mercado de usinagem, sendo referência desde sua fundação em 1988. Com tecnologia de ponta e uma equipe altamente qualificada, a empresa desenvolve soluções personalizadas, desde peças de alta precisão até máquinas de médio porte. A Usinagem JJ preza pela qualidade, inovação constante e pela construção de parcerias sólidas com seus clientes.

Descrição da Vaga – Torneiro CNC

Estamos em busca de um profissional para atuar como Torneiro CNC em nossa unidade de Jundiaí/SP, em regime presencial e integral. O profissional será responsável por programar e operar torno CNC, realizando a usinagem de peças não seriadas, garantindo qualidade, precisão e cumprimento de prazos.

Requisitos

  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Cursos profissionalizantes na área de usinagem;
  • Experiência comprovada na função.

Benefícios

  • Vale alimentação: R$ 250,00;
  • Vale combustível: R$ 250,00;
  • Convênio médico;
  • Convênio odontológico;
  • TotalPass;
  • PLR;
  • Refeição no local;
  • Estacionamento interno;
  • Seguro de vida.

Horário de Trabalho

  • Segunda a sexta-feira, das 14:48 às 00:36 (2o turno).

title: Supervisor de vendas
description:
NOSSO MAIOR CRÉDITO É A CONFIANÇA DAS PESSOAS.

Somos um grande time conectado pelos mesmos valores, e para cumprirmos essa missão, acreditamos que a confiança é fundamental nessa jornada.

Queremos sempre estar junto, somando forças e experiências para oferecer o melhor atendimento aos clientes.

Aqui na help incentivamos a participação de variados públicos em nossos processos seletivos, promovendo a candidatura de pessoas negras, mulheres, LGBTQIAP+, acima dos 50 anos e PCDs. Desse modo, não enviesamos perguntas de cunho pessoal, favorecendo e tornando nosso ambiente mais inclusivo, diverso e respeitoso, buscando aumentar a pluralidade dos times.

E nossas vagas são para todos que sintam essa vontade inquietante de pertencer e compor um time único, confiante e forte que tem orgulho de dizer: #somoshelpers!

O que te espera no dia a dia?

  • Gestão dos consultores da loja: acompanhar as vendas, dar suporte, contribuir com o desenvolvimento da equipe e garantir a entrega dos resultados;
  • Responsável por todos os processos administrativos da equipe;
  • Desenvolvimento e acompanhamento das estratégias comerciais;
  • Vendas de produtos financeiros e acionamentos junto à equipe;
  • Divulgação dos produtos;
  • Responsável pela abertura e fechamento da loja.

Esperamos que você tenha:

  • Necessário que o Supervisor de Vendas possua experiência com gestão de equipe de vendas de qualquer produto;
  • Necessário ter experiência com vendas e trabalhado com metas;
  • Desejável atuação com vendas de multiprodutos e experiências com vendas ativas por telefone e presenciais;
  • Perfil do Supervisor de Vendas: Proativo, resiliente, dinâmico, comunicativo, habilidade em negociação, organizado, senso de urgência, foco no cliente e nos resultados de vendas.
  • Ensino Médio Completo;
  • Conhecimento no Pacote Office;

Informações adicionais

Local de trabalho: São Paulo - Boituva

Jornada: 100% presencial

Horário de trabalho:

  • Segunda a quinta das 08h às 18h
  • Sexta feira das 08h às 17h

Remuneração:

Salário Fixo

Remuneração Variável

Benefícios, saúde e bem-estar:

  • Plano de saúde Unimed;
  • Plano odontológico MetLife;
  • Vale Refeição e/ou Alimentação;
  • Programa de Incentivo Educacional: Pagamos 100% da sua graduação, pós graduação, curso de idiomas ou cursos rápidos;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale transporte;
  • Acesse a Wellhub (antiga gympass), uma plataforma que oferece uma rede de parceiros para atividades físicas e de saúde, ajudando você a manter um estilo de vida ativo e saudável.
  • Paceria com a plataforma da Psicologia Viva, em que você e seus dependentes conseguem fazer sessões de terapia 100% online e gratuito;
  • PAP - Programa de assessoria financeira, jurídica e psicológica.

E por fim, e mais importante, acreditamos no protagonismo dos nossos colaboradores, afinal, não é apenas sobre métodos, agilidade e digitalização. É sobre pessoas e o potencial que elas têm!

Todo mundo é bem-vindo, investimos em uma cultura de respeito, diversa e inclusiva!

Esperemos você em nosso time

  • #somoshelpers! vem ser você também

title: Assessor de Investimentos
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Assessor(a) de Investimentos para atuar de forma estratégica no relacionamento com clientes, oferecendo soluções financeiras alinhadas aos objetivos e ao perfil de cada investidor.

Na EQI, o início da carreira é fortemente focado na formação de pessoas, com um modelo educacional estruturado e progressão de aprendizado intensiva. Esse processo é constantemente avaliado, sendo atrativo tanto para profissionais em fase inicial ou em transição de carreira, quanto para aqueles já experientes que buscam uma instituição que valoriza educação, resultado e evolução contínua.

Etapa Inicial Desde o primeiro dia, o profissional já atua como Assessor(a) de Investimentos, inserido em um modelo de formação intenso e educacional.

  • Onboarding Integração à cultura EQI, ferramentas e fundamentos técnicos e comerciais necessários para a atuação.
  • Desenvolvimento Comercial Atuação prática com foco em prospecção, geração de oportunidades e fortalecimento das habilidades de relacionamento.
  • Consolidação da Atuação Após o período de adaptação e com a consolidação dos resultados esperados, o(a) Assessor(a) passa a receber carteira de clientes EQI e inicia sua atuação completa, exercitando o modelo de assessoria da EQI com métricas e indicadores que acompanharão ao longo de toda a carreira.
  • Plano de Carreira O desenvolvimento começa já na formação e evolui de forma estruturada, com avaliações em cada etapa e oportunidades de crescimento até posições de maior senioridade.

O que importa no nosso processo seletivo?

  • Fit Cultural;
  • Certificação CPA-20 (CPA +CPROR), CEA (CPROI) ou CFP (ou interesse em tirar);
  • Conhecimento sobre Investimentos (RV, RF, Fundos, entre outros);
  • Perfil comercial e relacional;
  • Disponibilidade em tempo integral (100% presencial);
  • Experiência mínima de 6 meses de atuação profissional no Mercado Financeiro (Banco, Corretora, AAI ou Family Office).

Por que escolher a EQI?

  • Plano de carreira estruturado e diferenciado;
  • Suporte e acompanhamento integral das lideranças no dia a dia;
  • Feedbacks estruturados;
  • Sistemas avançados e tecnologias de ponta;
  • Plataformas próprias de desenvolvimento profissional (EaD) com mais de 350 treinamentos disponíveis (habilidades técnicas e comportamentais);
  • Possibilidade real de Partnership.

Informações adicionais

Benefícios:

Salário + PPR Anual

VA/VR de R$ 1.918

title: Especialista em Conciliação Analítica Contábil
description:
Sobre a Bip

Nascida em Milão no ano de 2003, temos uma história de crescimento exponencial. De 44 pessoas, hoje somos mais de 4500 em todo o mundo, presentes em 4 continentes e em mais de 14 países. Ao longo de todos esses anos crescemos significativamente e transformamos milhares de pessoas através do nosso trabalho!

Somos guiados por três grandes sonhos...

I. Ser a empresa que sempre sonhamos e que sonhamos para sempre

Espelha o desejo de evolução constante e perenizarão da empresa através de uma cultura forte centrada em pessoas e que essas pessoas pratiquem constantemente a ownership. Que para nós significa liberdade com autonomia de dono e responsabilidade pelo futuro da organização.

II. Presente em ecossistema inovador

Significa ter e desenvolver constantemente, internamente ou através de parceiros, soluções inovadoras que promovam impactos em nossos clientes e que sejam o pilar de nossa perenidade. Pois só um repensar constante nos manterá atuantes no mercado.

III. Socialmente Engajada

Conscientes dos aspectos sociais do nosso país, transformamos o nosso conhecimento, a nossa capacidade de execução e networking em impactos positivos e constantes.

Para realizar nossos sonhos, alcançar nossa visão e honrar o porquê existimos, precisamos fortalecer muito bem quem nós somos. Nunca esquecendo da nossa autenticidade e da nossa singularidade.

Nossos benefícios são flexíveis e você poderá distribuí-los de acordo com suas necessidades e interesses:

  • All Points (Programa de pontos para passagens áreas e hospedagens)
  • Assistência Médica
  • Assistência Odontológica
  • Seguro de vida
  • Meu Pet Club
  • Mobilidade (incluindo opção de combustível)
  • Reembolso Flex (óculos, vacinas, educação e outros)
  • Vale Refeição e/ou Vale Alimentação

Bem-estar: VT, Birthday off, Gympass, Licença Maternidade de 180 dias e Licença Paternidade de 30 dias, além de auxílio creche no primeiro ano do bebê.

Sobre a vaga:

Sobre a posição

Estamos em busca de um(a) Especialista em Conciliação Analítica Contábil para atuar em uma iniciativa estratégica de migração de processadora de Cartões de Crédito. O profissional será responsável por analisar dados e relatórios disponibilizados em ambiente GCP, desenvolver processos de conciliação contábil, validar a integridade das informações e identificar fragilidades nos controles e nas bases de dados.

A posição demanda elevada capacidade analítica, conhecimento contábil e experiência na construção de reconciliações que assegurem a rastreabilidade completa entre eventos operacionais, financeiros e contábeis.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Construir e executar conciliações analíticas contábeis das operações de Cartão de Crédito.
  • Realizar cruzamentos entre bases operacionais, financeiras e contábeis para validação da integridade das informações.
  • Analisar relatórios e tabelas disponíveis em ambiente GCP (BigQuery).
  • Desenvolver regras de negócio para reconciliação de eventos contábeis e financeiros.
  • Identificar divergências, quebras de fluxo, inconsistências de saldos e lançamentos não reconciliados.
  • Mapear fragilidades nos relatórios da processadora e propor melhorias de controle.
  • Validar a completude e acuracidade dos dados utilizados nos processos contábeis.
  • Estruturar controles preventivos e detectivos para mitigação de riscos.
  • Apoiar os processos de fechamento contábil e auditoria.
  • Elaborar indicadores de reconciliação, acompanhamento de pendências e qualidade dos dados.
  • Documentar fluxos, premissas e regras contábeis do processo de conciliação.
  • Atuar em conjunto com as áreas de Contabilidade, Produtos, Tecnologia, Dados, Operações e Controladoria.

Requisitos Obrigatórios

Formação

  • Graduação em Ciências Contábeis

Experiência

  • Experiência sólida em Conciliação Analítica Contábil.
  • Conhecimento das operações de Cartão de Crédito, produtos de crédito, financiamento e seguros.
  • Vivência em Instituições Financeiras, Bancos, Fintechs ou Processadoras.
  • Experiência na análise de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Atuação em projetos de implantação, migração ou transformação de processos financeiros.

Conhecimentos Técnicos

  • Conciliação Contábil e Reconciliação Analítica.
  • Fechamento Contábil.
  • Excel Avançado.
  • SQL Avançado.
  • GCP / BigQuery.
  • Power BI, Looker ou ferramentas de visualização.
  • Governança e Qualidade de Dados.
  • Controles Internos e Gestão de Riscos.

Competências

  • Perfil extremamente analítico.
  • Forte raciocínio lógico.
  • Capacidade investigativa.
  • Visão crítica para identificação de gaps e riscos.
  • Senso de prioridade e organização.
  • Boa comunicação e influência junto às áreas de negócio e tecnologia.

Vaga também para PcD

SOMOS DIFERENTES DE TUDO O QUE VOCÊ JÁ VIU!

Faça parte da BIP: Um ecossistema inovador, humano, ousado e revolucionário.

Somos uma consultoria internacional de transformação de negócios, fundada na Itália em 2003, há 20 anos impactando milhares de pessoas através do nosso trabalho.

Com nosso espírito jovem, vivemos em um ecossistema em evolução que entrega transformação significativa por meio de uma abordagem personalizada.

Por aqui, não falta oportunidade para você crescer.

ESTAMOS PRESENTE EM DIVERSOS LOCAIS DO MUNDO!

+40 países de atuação + 5000 Bipers pelo mundo +700 projetos no mercado

Tudo o que temos e construímos para um futuro que se aproxima, é guiado pelo nosso

PROPÓSITO:

Pursuing Changes, Nurturing Progress

A mudança é a base de nossa mentalidade, aprendemos e reaprendemos constantemente. Somos desafiadores, assumimos o risco de explorar novas formas de tornar as coisas melhores, inovadoras e sustentáveis para nós, para os nossos clientes e para a sociedade a qual pertencemos. Esforçamo-nos para criar o que ainda não existe, bem como para cuidar e fazer crescer o que existe. Não deixamos pedra sobre pedra – isso é o quão longe ousamos ir.

title: HR Generalist Specialist/Coordinator
description:
About Garena:

Established in 2009 and headquartered in Singapore , Garena is a leading online games developer and publisher with a global footprint across more than 130 markets.

Garena provides global users access to popular and engaging mobile and PC online games that it develops, curates, and localizes. It champions games as a social and entertainment platform on which its communities can engage and interact.

In addition, Garena is a leading esports organizer. It hosts esports events around the world that range from grassroots local tournaments to some of the most viewed professional esports competitions globally. The Free Fire World Series 2021 Singapore, which was watched by 5.4 million concurrent viewers at its peak, holds the record for the highest concurrent viewership of any esports match in history.

About the position:

We are looking for a HR Generalist Specialist/Coordinator who is committed and passionate about people! This role will be responsible for the full scope of HR generalist functions -- from employee lifecycle management, to talent development, to business partnering with local leadership and supporting initiatives from our HQ in Singapore.

Our ideal candidate would be able to run with us, adapt to our employees' needs, and stay humble throughout. If you are a driven person who wants to contribute to the gaming industry, we'd love to work with you!

Make sure to share your CV in English.

Exclusivity contract required.

Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the primary HR point of contact for all Garena Brazil employees, providing guidance and support across the full employee lifecycle (onboarding, performance management, development, offboarding)
  • Manage and oversee HR operations, ensuring compliance with CLT (Brazilian Labor Laws), Collective Labor Agreement, and applicable regulations
  • Lead employee engagement initiatives, including surveys, action planning, and team-level interventions
  • Oversee internal communications strategy and execution for the BR office
  • Manage Learning & Development programs, including budget administration, internal training, and vendor coordination
  • Partner with business leaders on workforce planning, organizational design, and talent management
  • Conduct compensation analysis and support salary proposals for new hires and internal movements
  • Coordinate performance review cycles (mid-year and year-end conversations)
  • Manage employee relations matters independently, including investigations, disciplinary actions, and conflict resolution
  • Represent the BR People team in cross-functional projects and HQ-driven initiatives
  • Contribute to People team related AI initiatives

Main job requirements:

  • 8+ years' experience in HR, with at least 3 years in a generalist or HR business partner capacity
  • Superior/higher degree completed
  • Strong knowledge of Brazilian labor law (CLT) and employment regulations is a must
  • Strong background in HR Operations is a must
  • Proven experience managing the full employee lifecycle independently
  • Excellent communication skills in Portuguese and English (written and spoken) is a must
  • Strong stakeholder management skills - able to influence and advise senior leaders
  • Strong ethics, discretion, and judgment in handling sensitive matters
  • Experience with employee engagement, L&D, and talent development
  • Ability to work autonomously with minimal supervision
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills is a must
  • Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint)
  • Experience in the tech or gaming industry is a plus
  • Experience in using or developing AI solutions
  • Team player with a collaborative mindset
  • Available to work in person at our office in São Paulo, SP (Hybrid mode).

title: Garena Trainee 2027
description:
Are you ready to turn your passion for gaming into a high-impact career? At Garena, we don't just play games; we build global communities and manage the operations of the world's most popular digital entertainment titles—including the global phenomenon Free Fire.

We are looking for fresh graduates to join our Garena Trainee 2027. From Day 1, you will be embedded into the core of our daily operations, collaborating with talented peers and regional teams across the globe. You will work to support and execute our business strategies with direct guidance and support from local leadership.

Select your track:

Track A: Game Marketing - Focus on how our games reach and resonate with millions. You will master:

  • Performance Marketing & User Acquisition (UA).
  • Branding and Community building.
  • Managing influencer tribes and massive local campaigns.

Track B: Game Operations - Focus on the "engine" that keeps our games alive and profitable. You will master:

  • Game Economy and Monetization strategies.
  • Planning and executing major in-game events.
  • Data analysis to optimize player retention and experience.

Global Sync: Beyond Borders

At Garena, "Global" isn't just a buzzword—it's your daily routine. You will be part of a truly international squad, collaborating daily with our offices in Asia and across the globe. From morning syncs to large-scale global campaign rollouts, you will use your English to navigate different cultures and contribute to a business that never sleeps. If you're looking for a role where your work has no borders, you've found it!

Our Ideal Candidate

You are a driven and resilient professional who thrives in fast-paced environments and complex challenges. You bring:

  • Passion: A deep enthusiasm for gaming and a fearless curiosity to explore new ideas and territories.
  • Aptitude: A natural ability to quickly learn and master new skills, tools, and methodologies.
  • Drive: Unwavering commitment to overcoming obstacles and pushing boundaries to achieve your goals.

Requirements

  • Education: Higher degree (Bacharelado, Tecnólogo ou Licenciatura) completed between Dec/2023 and Dec/2026.
  • Languages: Fluent in Portuguese and English, with proficiency in reading, writing, and speaking.
  • Passion for games: You must be an active player, have deep knowledge of gaming mechanics, meta-trends, and player psychology.
  • Availability: able to work in a hybrid model for 8 hours a day in São Paulo/SP.

Why join the Garena Squad?

Joining Garena means entering a high-octane environment where you will deal with the scale and complexity of a global gaming leader. Here, you will be part of a team that tackles real-world business challenges and manages the lifecycle of massive titles in real-time. While you will have access to guidance from experienced professionals and opportunities for professional growth, our focus is on ownership and impact. If you are looking for a fast-paced environment where your work directly affects millions of players, this is the right place for you.

Our Perks & Rewards:

  • Competitive Salary
  • CLT Contract
  • Health Insurance
  • Dental Assistance
  • Meal Allowance
  • Transport/Mobility voucher
  • Life Insurance
  • Wellhub (Gympass)
  • Learning Budget: Subsidy for formal and continuing education to keep you leveling up (available after 12 months of service).
  • Childcare Subsidy: Monthly reimbursement for daycare or nanny expenses.
  • Extended Parental Leave: 180 days for maternity leave and 20 days for paternity leave.
  • Travel Insurance

Selection process:

  • Application via LinkedIn
  • Online Assessment: Logic & English (Always check your e-mail and spam box!)
  • HR Interview
  • Business Case
  • Case Interview with Hiring Manager
  • Final Interview with Senior Leadership

Are you ready to Join the Game? Apply now and show us why you are the perfect fit for Garena.

title: ADVOGADO(A) JÚNIOR - Direito Imobiliário
description:
Descrição da Empresa

Fundado em 1992, o Choaib, Paiva e Justo Advogados Associados está entre os mais destacados escritórios brasileiros dos setores tributário, private banking, sucessório, societário, internacional, imobiliário, cível, desportivo e entretenimento.

Com foco nas áreas preventiva, consultiva e contenciosa, opera no Brasil e no exterior como boutique jurídica atendendo empresas de médio e grande porte, pessoas físicas e instituições financeiras, tendo como preceitos a qualidade dos serviços prestados, o compromisso com os clientes e o atendimento pessoal e personalizado, agregando amplo conhecimento das áreas de direito, por meio de uma equipe de advogados altamente especializados.

Sediado em São Paulo, o Choaib, Paiva e Justo Advogados Associados possui escritórios no Rio de Janeiro (RJ), Miami (EUA) e Lisboa (Portugal) e é parceiro da Brazilian-American Chamber of Commerce of Florida (EUA), com a qual administra palestras e oferece orientações jurídicas destinadas a executivos, empresários, e empreendedores brasileiros que têm o interesse de expandir seus negócios, iniciar um novo projeto ou realizar o processo imigratório profissional no país.

VAGA ADVOGADO(A) JÚNIOR – Direito Imobiliário

Atuação voltada ao Direito Imobiliário com foco em demandas relacionadas a empresas do setor, além de pessoas físicas e jurídicas em geral, assessorando e conduzindo operações jurídicas diversificadas neste segmento.

Experiências, Capacidades e Conhecimentos

  • Conhecimento da legislação relacionada a incorporação imobiliária, loteamento, locação, arrendamento, contratos de "shopping center", fundos de investimento imobiliário, contratos de empreitada e prestação de serviços, em suas diversas modalidades;
  • Elaboração de compromissos de venda e compra;
  • Confecção de contratos de locação, empreitada, prestação de serviços, dentre outros contratos imobiliários nominados e inominados;
  • Preparo e análise de minutas de escritura;
  • Organização e análise de documentação imobiliária;
  • Redação de notificações judiciais e extrajudiciais;
  • Conhecimento do sistema de Registros Públicos, especialmente do registro de imóveis;
  • Experiência em processos administrativos e judiciais relacionados à área imobiliária (ações de despejo, renovatória, revisional de aluguel, usucapião, desapropriação, retificação de área, dentre outros);
  • Conhecimento de sociedades imobiliárias, tais como SPE, SCP, Consórcios Imobiliários e parcerias;
  • Domínio de assuntos relacionados a condomínios residenciais, comerciais e industriais;
  • Desejável conhecimento de direito ambiental e normatização urbanística (estatuto da cidade, zoneamento, restrições edilícias, uso e parcelamento do solo).

Requisitos da Vaga

  • Graduação em Direito (desejável pós-graduação, concluída ou em curso);
  • Mínimo 2 (dois) anos de formação;
  • Experiência comprovada na área, conforme descrição acima;
  • Pacote Office avançado, principalmente Word, Excel e Power Point;
  • Redação própria e boa comunicação oral;
  • Perfil organizado e comprometido com prazos e com capacidade de atendimento de múltiplas demandas; e
  • Inglês (conversação e escrita).

Este profissional será responsável por garantir a excelência no relacionamento com o cliente, atuando como elo entre as áreas internas da Scanntech e os stakeholders da conta, promovendo alinhamento, governança, geração de insights e identificação de oportunidades de negócio. A posição exige forte capacidade analítica, perfil consultivo, maturidade profissional, autonomia e habilidade para conduzir múltiplas demandas em um ambiente dinâmico e de alta complexidade.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Atuar como principal ponto de contato, garantindo o relacionamento próximo e consultivo;
  • Construir e manter relacionamento com stakeholders do cliente, incluindo equipes de Trade Marketing, Inteligência de Mercado, Comercial e lideranças da indústria;
  • Realizar reuniões periódicas de acompanhamento, alinhamento e apresentação de resultados;
  • Gerar análises e insights estratégicos a partir dos dados da Scanntech, apoiando a tomada de decisão do cliente;
  • Identificar oportunidades de crescimento, expansão de projetos e novas aplicações dos produtos e serviços da companhia;
  • Garantir o acompanhamento e a gestão das demandas do cliente junto às áreas internas;
  • Atuar na organização, priorização e governança das entregas, assegurando qualidade, prazos e alinhamento entre as partes;
  • Elaborar apresentações executivas, relatórios e materiais de acompanhamento de performance;
  • Conduzir análises de mercado, categorias, canais e indicadores de desempenho;
  • Participar de visitas presenciais à base do cliente, com frequência estimada de uma vez por semana, podendo ocorrer em formato quinzenal conforme necessidade.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino superior completo;
  • Domínio avançado de Excel;
  • Experiência prévia em atendimento a clientes externos, gestão de contas ou relacionamento comercial;
  • Vivência em varejo, indústria de bens de consumo, inteligência de mercado, trade marketing, comercial ou áreas correlatas;
  • Forte capacidade analítica e habilidade para transformar dados em recomendações acionáveis;
  • Experiência na condução simultânea de múltiplas demandas e projetos;
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita;
  • Capacidade de negociação e relacionamento com diferentes níveis hierárquicos;

  • Atuar ativamente em parceria com a área comercial na prospecção de clientes através de estudos de capacidade econômica e financeira dos mesmos.

  • Participar da definição, revisão e implementação das políticas, normas e procedimentos de crédito da companhia, contribuindo para o equilíbrio entre crescimento de vendas e mitigação de riscos.
  • Preparar e apresentar estudos, pareceres e recomendações de crédito para os fóruns de aprovação e comitês internos, quando aplicável.
  • Monitorar e analisar indicadores de desempenho da área de Crédito e Cobrança, elaborando planos de ação para mitigação de riscos e melhoria dos resultados.
  • Liderar iniciativas de melhoria contínua, automação e simplificação de processos relacionados à gestão de crédito, contribuindo para o aumento da eficiência operacional e da qualidade das análises
  • Suporte à gestão, alta direção e áreas clientes, atuando como focal point para a orientação de conceitos e informações financeiras para tomada de decisão.
  • Disponibilidade de viagens para aperfeiçoamento do relacionamento entre clientes e a Sherwin-Williams.

  • Estar sempre informado das suas atribuições, responsabilidades e consequências de suas atividades no trabalho, comportamento e tomadas de decisões, que resultarão em seu desempenho profissional
  • Prestar atendimento e realizar outras atividades profissionais correlatas e inerentes ao cargo exercido, conforme orientação e/ou solicitação do superior imediato.
  • Atuar como referência técnica para os analistas da área, apoiando o desenvolvimento da equipe e compartilhando melhores práticas de análise e gestão de crédito

title: Sales Director, LATAM (Brazil)
description:
Sales Director, LATAM (Brazil)

Reports To: Head Of Media Sales & Service, LATAM

Location: Brazil, Remote (São Paulo)

About us

Broadsign is a leading programmatic ad tech company on a mission to make buying, selling, and delivering out-of-home media easier than ever. Our platform powers the world's most successful OOH and retail media businesses while enabling agencies and brands to seamlessly plan and execute dynamic OOH campaigns across the globe. Come light up the world as a Sales Director.

Position Summary

Your day-to-day will vary but your mission is simple; as a key member of our Programmatic Team, you will be taking full responsibility for business development activities by educating buyers on the new opportunities brought forth by our products. Your patch will consist of media buyers from agencies, brands and DSP partners. You'll put your sales experience to use by determining client needs and recommending optimal programmatic DOOH proposals and supporting agency-wide agreements.

Of course, if this role speaks to you, you're someone who has;

  • 5-10 years sales experience in the media world; you understand agencies and what advertisers care about
  • Proven understanding of the digital programmatic world and/or the programmatic digital out-of-home ecosystem
  • Interest in engaging with new buyers by introducing them to the benefits of programmatic DOOH and the innovative advertising opportunities via the Broadsign programmatic stack
  • Excellent presentation skills - you know how to craft a pitch
  • Strong organisational skills
  • You have the ability to manage multiple tasks and perform well under pressure
  • Great communication and collaborative approach with teammates
  • This is a primarily remote role; however, we believe face-to-face connection drives the best results. You will be expected to make a best-effort approach to conducting in-person client meetings. To support your success, you will have full access to WeWork spaces.
  • Travel will primarily be within Brazil for client meetings, with occasional travel throughout LATAM for industry and company events.
  • This role requires professional fluency in English and Portuguese; proficiency in Spanish is highly advantageous.

What we bring to the table

  • Health & Dental Insurance: Supplemental private medical and dental coverage for you and your dependents. You'll also have access to unlimited online mental health support through BetterHelp for you and your family.
  • Wellness & Remote Fund: R$ 3,000 annual flexible budget for home office, wellness, or internet expenses
  • Paid Time Off: Statutory 30 calendar days of paid rest after 12 months, plus the mandatory 1/3 vacation bonus, 5 "floater" days, 2 paid volunteer days, and 3 paid training days per year!
  • Daycare Assistance: Monthly financial support/reimbursement for early-childhood daycare (Auxílio-Creche)
  • Family Support: Parental leave salary supplement.
  • Growth Opportunities: Training & development opportunities with a yearly budget to support professional growth.

At Broadsign, we value the varied social identities that make up our community. We recognize talent comes in different forms and encourage applications that reflect different backgrounds and experiences. Our promise is to be an inclusive employer and partner, open to learning, with thoughtful strategies and practices that amplify the different voices of our industry.

title: Localization QA Specialist - Brazilian Portuguese
description:
Why We Need You:

We're on the hunt for a native Brazilian Portuguese speaker to join our localization crew. You'll be the human voice that makes our AI-powered imaging and design apps feel effortlessly natural in Brazil — because even the smartest AI needs a real person to catch the subtle stuff and bring the right vibe. If you're the kind of person who notices a misplaced comma from across the room and gets a kick out of making tech feel truly local, let's talk.

What You'll Do:

  • UI Copy Refinement: Proofread and refine AI-translated copy across buttons, dialogs, notifications, settings, and other UI elements to nail accuracy, flow, consistency, and a tone that feels natural for the Brazilian market.
  • In-App Linguistic QA: Run in-app linguistic QA — verify translations display correctly, catch truncation, layout quirks, context slips, and anything that might read as culturally off or awkward in Brazilian Portuguese.
  • Cultural Alignment: Review in-app copy to make sure it aligns with local language habits, user expectations, and cultural norms in Brazil, flagging content that feels unnatural or insensitive.
  • Marketing Localization: Translate, review, and localize marketing content like promos, App Store listings, push notifications, in-app campaigns, and social media posts so they resonate with Brazilian users.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Team up with product, design, and engineering to spot localization issues early and push overall quality higher.

Who You Are:

  • Native Fluency: Native Brazilian Portuguese speaker with a rock-solid command of grammar, idiomatic expressions, and cultural intuition in your language.
  • Hands-On Experience: 1+ year of hands-on localization, UI translation, or linguistic QA experience for apps, software, or websites.
  • Sharp Detail Orientation: Sharp eye for translation flubs, term inconsistencies, UI truncation, formatting hiccups, and cultural mismatches — you genuinely care about polish and getting every detail right.
  • UI/UX Awareness: Comfortable with UI/UX fundamentals like character limits, responsive layouts, and how translated text behaves inside different interface components.
  • Transcreation Skills: Strong copywriting and transcreation skills — you can adapt marketing copy while keeping the brand's voice, tone, and intent intact.

Nice-to-Haves:

  • Familiarity with CAT tools and AI-assisted translation workflows.
  • Background or strong interest in AI, imaging, or photo editing apps.

title: Senior Warehouse Supervisor - Guarulhos
description:
ABOUT SHEIN

SHEIN is a global fashion and lifestyle e-retailer committed to making fashion accessible to all. We use on-demand manufacturing technology to connect suppliers to our agile supply chain, reducing inventory waste and enabling us to deliver a variety of affordable products to customers around the world. From our global offices, we reach customers in 160 countries. Founded in 2012, SHEIN has nearly 17,000 employees operating from offices around the world, with its Brazil headquarters located in São Paulo.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking a Senior Warehouse Supervisor to oversee daily logistics operations within a business unit, ensuring operational efficiency, productivity, quality, and compliance with established Service Level Agreements (SLAs).

This role will be responsible for coordinating warehouse activities across Receiving, Stocking, Shipping, Sorting, and Inventory, ensuring that operational processes are executed effectively and that teams are properly guided and supported to achieve business objectives.

The professional will also play an important role in monitoring operational performance, identifying opportunities for continuous improvement, solving operational issues, and implementing corrective actions to enhance overall warehouse performance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Supervise daily logistics operations within the assigned business unit, ensuring activities are completed within established deadlines and quality standards.
  • Lead and engage employees in compliance with Occupational Health and Safety, Quality, and Environmental policies, as well as company standards and procedures.
  • Ensure the effective execution and maintenance of existing operational processes, while proactively identifying opportunities for improvement and greater efficiency.
  • Oversee key warehouse activities, including Receiving, Stocking, Shipping, Sorting, and Inventory, prioritizing and distributing tasks according to operational needs.
  • Provide guidance and support to the team, addressing operational challenges and resolving issues that may impact productivity, quality, or service levels.
  • Monitor operational progress and performance, identifying deviations and implementing corrective actions to ensure compliance with SLAs, productivity targets, and quality standards.
  • Track and analyze key operational performance indicators (KPIs), using data and logistics studies to identify trends, operational gaps, and opportunities to improve overall warehouse performance.
  • Coordinate physical inventory activities, ensuring proper execution and taking the necessary actions to maintain inventory accuracy.
  • Contribute to the implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of quality standards within the area of responsibility.
  • Provide regular feedback, guidance, and performance insights to leaders and coordinators, supporting team development and operational excellence.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to ensure alignment between logistics operations and broader business requirements.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree or above in Engineering, Business Administration, Logistics, Supply Chain Management, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of professional experience in logistics or supply chain, preferably with experience in logistics operations, continuous improvement, distribution, supply chain, or demand planning.
  • Previous experience supervising or coordinating logistics or warehouse operations.
  • Strong problem-solving and data analysis skills, with the ability to interpret operational data and make sound, data-driven decisions.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify operational inefficiencies and implement practical solutions to improve productivity, quality, and service levels.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with customers, peers, direct reports, and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment, managing multiple priorities while maintaining operational excellence.
  • Advanced English proficiency.
  • Availability to work shifts in Guarulhos.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in large-scale warehouse, fulfillment, distribution center, or e-commerce operations.
  • Experience with KPI management, operational performance analysis, inventory accuracy, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Familiarity with Lean, Six Sigma, or other continuous improvement methodologies.
  • Experience working in high-volume and rapidly changing logistics environments.

Por meio da lealdade de nossos clientes, que nos permitiu crescer expressivamente nos últimos anos, a Lockton hoje está entre as maiores corretoras de seguro do mundo, conquistando a taxa de crescimento orgânico mais rápida do mercado de corretoras.

Responsável pela administração e operacionalização dos benefícios seguráveis e não seguráveis da empresa, atuando como ponto focal entre colaboradores, RH, corretora e fornecedores, garantindo a correta manutenção dos processos, o cumprimento das regras contratuais e a qualidade do atendimento prestado aos beneficiários.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Gestão operacional dos benefícios de Saúde, Odontológico, Seguro de Vida e Academia;
  • Realização de movimentações cadastrais, incluindo inclusões, alterações e exclusões de titulares e dependentes;
  • Controle e processamento do faturamento dos benefícios, contemplando baixa de arquivos, conferência de rateios e envio para pagamento;
  • Acompanhamento e controle do pagamento de faturas junto aos fornecedores;
  • Monitoramento da maioridade de dependentes e orientação quanto às regras de permanência nos planos;
  • Conferência e validação das bases cadastrais, identificando inconsistências, carências indevidas e oportunidades de saneamento de dados;
  • Atendimento e orientação aos colaboradores sobre coberturas, elegibilidade, regras contratuais e regulamentações da ANS;
  • Intermediação de demandas junto às operadoras e prestadores de serviço, acompanhando solicitações, liberações e tratativas administrativas;
  • Suporte e acompanhamento de processos relacionados a cirurgias, internações e demais procedimentos de maior complexidade;
  • Atuação preventiva na identificação de riscos operacionais e oportunidades de melhoria dos processos de benefícios;
  • Elaboração de controles, indicadores e reports relacionados à gestão dos benefícios corporativos.

Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Domínio de benefícios corporativos;
  • Conhecimento operacional em seguradoras, operadoras e fornecedores de benefícios seguráveis e não seguráveis;
  • Experiência com processos de movimentação cadastral;
  • Leitura, conferência e validação de faturas e subfaturas;
  • Conhecimento das regras de elegibilidade, coberturas e movimentações de benefícios;
  • Noções de legislação trabalhista aplicada a benefícios e regulamentações da ANS;
  • Excel intermediário;
  • Experiência em atendimento a colaboradores e interface com RH, fornecedores e operadoras.

title: Profissional de Patentes | Análise Técnica e Redação Patentária
description:
Profissional de Patentes | Análise Técnica e Redação Patentária

Venha construir uma nova área de Patentes na Peduti Advogados

A Peduti Advogados, referência em Propriedade Intelectual e Tecnologia, está formando seu time interno de patentes e busca profissionais experientes para atuação técnica especializada.

title: Agente de Relacionamento
description:
Somos a Seguros Unimed, a Seguradora do Sistema Unimed, uma empresa criada por médicos e que tem o cooperativismo na essência. Cuidamos das instituições e das pessoas, para que possam viver bem o presente e planejar o futuro com segurança. Acreditamos que a cooperação nos conecta para crescermos juntos.

Pelo 7o ano consecutivo, a Seguros Unimed integra o ranking dos Lugares Mais Incríveis para Trabalhar 2025, da FIA e do Estadão. E este ano, alcançamos o patamar MÁXIMO: somos O MAIS INCRÍVEL!

Além disso, você encontra por aqui:

  • Trilha de desenvolvimento;
  • Plataforma exclusiva com treinamentos;
  • Programa de Desenvolvimento Profissional;
  • Ambiente de Trabalho Inovador;
  • Oportunidades de Crescimento na Organização;
  • Diversas parcerias e descontos pela região.

No seu dia-a-dia :

  • Atender chamadas de clientes, corretores e prestadores, identificando suas necessidades, esclarecendo dúvidas e atendendo ou direcionando suas solicitações.
  • Atendimento multiskill a diversos produtos, com acessos aos diferentes sistemas para realizar o atendimento.
  • Atuar no SAC que exige maior conhecimento dos produtos sendo responsável por Cancelamentos de Propostas e Planos, acolhimento das insatisfações manifestadas por nossos clientes apoiando a liderança na resolução imediata e/ou realizar o registro e direcionamento das reclamações que necessitam da análise e/ou atuação das áreas responsáveis.

Esperamos de você:

  • Ensino Superior Cursando ou Completo;
  • Conhecimento no pacote office;
  • Experiência com central de relacionamento - atendimento ativo via telefone;
  • Vivência com indicadores e metas de central de relacionamento (TMA, TME, NPS, entre outros);

Informações adicionais:

  • Vaga extensiva a Pessoas com Deficiência - PCD;
  • Tipo de contrato: CLT;
  • Local de trabalho: Jardins, próximo à Avenida Paulista;
  • Todos os nossos processos seletivos são totalmente on-line nas etapas iniciais.

A Seguros Unimed respeita a pluralidade de identidades e trabalha para promover uma cultura inclusiva. Não fazemos distinção de raça, cor, religião, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade em nenhuma etapa do processo seletivo, reforçando nosso compromisso de uma empresa focada em cooperar e no seu cliente interno e externo.

title: Business Analyst
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Business Analyst who wants to learn and transform his career.

Responsibilities

  • Own translation of user needs into detailed, ready-to-build requirements for the squad.
  • Define and document benefit hypotheses and testable acceptance criteria for backlog features.
  • Write clear, unambiguous user stories and acceptance criteria using BDD/Gherkin, user-centric principles and INVEST.
  • Use quantitative data to influence product decisions and operationalize PO-approved plans.
  • Partner with the PO to ensure backlog alignment with business priorities (PO retains final prioritization, scope changes and release sign-off).
  • Keep work 2–3 sprints ahead of the squad; ensure each feature meets DoR and DoD and is sprint-ready.
  • Partner with the Scrum Master to assess team capacity, participate in rituals, and help define DoR/DoD.
  • Facilitate and lead refinement sessions with the squad.
  • Map and manage interdependencies across products and teams; coordinate with PO and Product Manager.
  • Identify key unknowns, propose alternatives, and manage spikes within sprints to reduce risk.
  • Communicate product vision and functional intent to developers and testers; drive improvements to user experience.
  • Communicate risks and impediments; support trade-offs and ROAM-based decision making with the PO.
  • Document confirmed business processes as authoritative references for stakeholders (end users, development, IT support).
  • Identify process bottlenecks and collaborate with PO, SM, QA/TQ and the squad to mitigate them.
  • Support and/or facilitate system demos (inspect-and-adapt) as needed.
  • Support UAT activities as required (write scripts and/or guide business users on test execution), depending on the product.

Skills Required.

  • 5+ years' experience as a Product Analyst.
  • Proven knowledge of product and industry best practices.
  • Strong technical written and verbal English; comfortable with technical documentation.
  • Strong problem-solving and judgment; solid understanding of customer journeys and customer experience.
  • Intermediate SQL for ad-hoc queries and data analysis.
  • Experience managing product backlogs and release plans; tracking team metrics and removing blockers.
  • Proficient with Agile frameworks (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) and tools (JIRA, Confluence).
  • Data Modeling & Architecture: Data warehousing, Data lakes, Data pipelines.
  • Deep understanding of business processes and high-quality digital product delivery.
  • Demonstrated leadership influencing cross-functional, self-organizing teams.
  • Comfortable working in complex, diverse and fast-changing environments; adapts quickly to evolving priorities.
  • Able to deliver high-quality work during uncertainty and ambiguity.
  • Advocates and fosters a data-driven culture focused on measurable outcomes and business agility.
  • Willingness to challenge assumptions and contribute constructive, innovative ideas.
  • Nice to have: IIBA (business analysis) or PSPO/CSPO (Product Owner) certifications — PSPO/CSPO useful if the candidate may act as an ad-hoc deputy PO.

What can you expect from us?

  • Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.
  • Opportunities to work outside Brazil
  • A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

Well-being & Benefits

Health, dental, and life insurance, meal and transportation vouchers, childcare assistance, Gym pass, and 24/7 support through TCS Cares (psychological, legal, social and financial assistance). Access to cultural, wellness, and recreational programs through TCS- SESC partnership.

Learning & Career Development

Global career opportunities through access to the latest technologies, world-class learning platforms, professional certifications, and mentorship programs designed to accelerate your growth and future-ready skills

At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer! title: Sales Specialist
description:
Expand your horizons and bring the technology closer to people with BGI #OMICSFORALL

BGI Genomics was founded in 1999 with the vision of using genomics to benefit mankind and has since become the largest genomic life science organization in the world. With a focus on research and applications in the healthcare, agriculture, conservation, and environmental fields, BGI has a proven track record of innovative, high-profile research, which has generated over 2,000 publications, many in top-tier journals such as Nature and Science. BGI now operating and serving customers in more than 100 countries and areas and with around 10,000 employees all over the world.

Our mission is to transform people's lives for the better. We don't hesitate to take bold decisions that can help us to achieve new breakthroughs. We believe that the success of our business will mean a better world for people to live in.

Our message to the world is simple – make everyone's life healthier and longer with help of BGI.

Why joining us?

Here at BGI we bring the most talented and dedicated to science and business professionals to act as one to deliver the outstanding technology and services to people.

Our multicultural team is engaged in a challenging work that brings satisfaction and unlimited professional growth. We keep learning and upgrading ourselves, we support each other in order to achieve the best result.

Why do we want you?

We invite to partner only the best experts who will work side by side promoting BGI's values, products and services. And that's why, we are confident that your business expertise and deep knowledge of genomics will help us deliver our message to the world and build strong relationship with a community.

Job Purpose & Principal Accountabilities:

  • Responsible for formulating and implementing an effective sales plan, achieving the regional sales goals within the forecasted budget, and developing a key account sales strategy.
  • Understand and master the company's current portfolio of products and services. Stay abreast of technology developments, market competition, laws, and regulations relevant to the business. Use resources and research to identify the sales plan and strategy for different market segments.
  • Carry on regional business analysis and report to regional managers regularly. Evaluate the budget performance, product performance, and operational efficiency, and report recommendations and results to the team's leader.
  • Screen for relevant business opportunities in R&D, clinical and pharmaceutical fields. Develop and maintain relationships with key opinion leaders; use clients' resources and feedback to expand the influence of BGI and safeguard key market opportunities.
  • Work in coordination with project managers, production teams, and others to guarantee the smooth implementation of the project and timely and correctly communicate the project status to the clients. Work with product managers to promote product development through collaboration with key customers.
  • Participate in national and regional conferences, trade fairs, and company meetings.
  • Understand BGI's values and expand BGI's vision in overseas markets.

Job Knowledge, Skills, and Experience:

  • In-depth knowledge of NGS and IVD markets and customer needs in this industry.
  • In-depth knowledge of selling next-generation sequencing and other genomic services such as microarray, genotyping, in vitro diagnosis, etc.
  • Experience with government relations and lobbying for the pharmaceutical and biotech industry.
  • Excellent communication, analytical and organizational skills.
  • Willingness to travel.
  • Fluency in English, (Chinese preferred )

7.Base Sao Paulo.

Competences:

a. At least two years of experience in customer management in the biotechnology or Healthcare industry.

b. A Bachelor's Degree or above in biology, biochemistry, molecular biology, bioinformatics or equivalent.

Here at BGI we value people and consider our employees as partners. Transparent, fair and friendly environment is what we created here. Agile approach in management is what we implement here and we give each partner enough independence as well as guidance. We take care of our partners' physical and mental health and we are dedicated to the life-work balance corporate culture.

Not only do we bring genomics closer to people, we also participate in various charity programs, advocate nature preservation, and support equality. We condemn any discrimination and committed to giving job opportunity to everyone regardless of sex, race, gender, religion, marital status, domestic partner status, age, national origin or ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, sexual orientation, pregnancy, military or veteran status, citizenship status etc.

· What do we offer?

  • International, cross-cultural, and cross-functional team
  • work with advanced technology and products
  • comprehensive onboarding program
  • continuous knowledge and skills development
  • HQ organized training globally and in China
  • official permanent work agreement and all social benefits
  • annual performance bonus
  • team building activities
  • salary range BRL 7.500 - 11.500 gross monthly.

Let's move to the brighter and more equal future together and deliver #Omicsforall

title: Learning Support Teacher
description:
Job Overview:

The Learning Support Teacher plays a crucial, integral role in ensuring high-quality learning support for students, serving as a key advocate and model for inclusive and equitable approaches to education. This position requires a commitment to understanding and addressing the unique learning profiles of every student, working in direct partnership with teachers and staff to foster an environment where all students can thrive. The Learning Support Teacher reports to the Principal, while receiving specialized technical guidance, instruction, and collaborative supervision from the Student Services Coordinator, always serving the best educational interests of the School and its students.

Core Responsibilities:

Student Support & Intervention

  • Work in collaboration with teachers to design and provide support for students identified as requiring support.
  • Responsible for creating, updating, and implementing Student Support Plans (SSP) and Individual Education Plans (IEP), alongside the Student Services Coordinator.
  • Collaborate and update Student Observation and Action Plan (SOAP) as the internal documentation of identified needs and strategies.
  • Attend SOAP meetings, to contribute with insights and observations of referred students collaborating with the action plan and strategies moving forward.
  • Provide individual and small-group support to identified students. This includes academic, social, emotional, behavioral support through creating opportunities.
  • Assist students in developing organizational, self-management, and problem-solving skills.
  • Attend grade-level planning meetings to design and advocate for accessible learning.
  • Participate in learning support team meetings to contribute with the reflection and improvement of best practice, housekeeping and guidelines are services offered.
  • Implement accommodations, modifications, and adaptations to the learning environment or learning experiences (curriculum, assignments, and assessments) in collaboration with teachers and in accordance with students' plans.
  • Build strong, supportive relationships with families and students to encourage student success.
  • Communicate regularly with parents/guardians regarding student progress, concerns, and intervention strategies.
  • Participate in family meetings, conferences, and reviews of support plans.
  • Provide support to enable students with learning differences to access the curriculum and show understanding.
  • Support the development and maintenance of EAC's Student Services and Learning Support policies and approaches, particularly in relation to students with unique learning profiles.
  • Oversee grade checks, missing work reports, and academic risk monitoring, as required.
  • Maintain documentation of intervention and support sessions. Add and update Child Study Team Meeting documents with notes when communicating with the family.
  • Track student progress using school data systems and report trends or concerns to administration.
  • Co-lead Child Study Team Meetings (ES) / SSP/IEP Meetings (US) alongside the Student Services Coordinator.
  • Assess and facilitate the implementation of accommodations requirements for students during assessments.
  • Provide feedback and encouragement to parents, with respect to how they can support their children.
  • Identify and implement/supervise accommodations and modifications to the regular curriculum for students with specific needs.
  • Work with the Student Services Coordinator to keep accurate records of student achievement and provide suitable communication and reports to parents and teachers.
  • Promote practices based on sound educational research (ensuring evidence‐based practices are implemented).
  • Attend professional development opportunities or training as appropriate, with the aim of maintaining currency of teacher registration and professional knowledge.

Collaboration

  • Liaise with the various external professionals, teachers, and families to focus on the needs of individual students, with the purpose of facilitating appropriate learning support or enrichment/extension.
  • Partner with teachers to implement classroom accommodations, modifications, and behavior supports.
  • Monitor students' progress and well-being.
  • Provide professional development and resources to Teachers serving diverse learners.
  • Develop positive working partnerships with students, families, and staff to support, improve, and extend students' learning.
  • Interact empathetically with children and their families, showing concern for the well-being and learning of all children.
  • Participate actively in Grade-Level Meetings providing additional information about students with plans and suggestions for strategies to support students and improve teaching and learning.
  • Help develop, monitor, and review behavior plans for students with recurring challenges on the case load.
  • Support teachers with classroom management strategies as needed.
  • Coordinate interventions such as homework clubs, study halls, or academic support blocks.

Operational and Professional Conduct

  • Uphold professional standards by adhering to EAC Teacher Handbook procedures and assisting in enforcing school policies.
  • Communicate effectively with parents, students, and staff regarding student progress.
  • Maintain accurate student records.
  • Collaborate with colleagues to share ideas, materials, and methods.
  • Participate in professional development opportunities.
  • Actively engage in school life and perform assigned supervisory duties, when assigned.
  • Promptly report maintenance concerns and order necessary supplies following school guidelines.
  • Follow the EAC Safeguarding Guide.

Other duties, as assigned.

Working Conditions:

  • Walk on paths and rough terrain
  • May include lifting educational structures and materials for class set up

POSITION REQUIREMENTS

Minimum Education Required:

BA or Specialization in Special Education. Neuropsychology, psychopedagogy or equivalent

Minimum Experience Required:

  • Five years of teaching experience, preferred
  • Experience working with learners with learning and/or developmental differences.
  • Experience working in a school setting or educational environment.

Specific Knowledge:

  • Neurodiversity and best practices in education for diverse learners.
  • Whole child student-centered and solution-oriented.
  • Committed to the development of the professional self in accordance with EAC's Teacher Standards.

Other Skills (Desirable):

  • Approachable, with exceptional interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Able to manage difficult situations, be learner focused and data driven.
  • Collegial and collaborative.
  • Innovative and creative.
  • Organized, adaptable and able to work well under pressure.

English level required:

C1 or above

Portuguese level required:

none for teachers instructing in English

C1 or above for teachers instructing in Portuguese

Child Safeguarding

Our school is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and have developed and adopted written guidelines (Code of Conduct) for appropriate and inappropriate behavior of adults towards children. We expect all staff, volunteers and other third parties to share this commitment and to review and affirm that they have read, understood, and will abide by the Code of Conduct. At our school, we use safer recruitment practice and pre-employment background checks, to maintain the highest standards of safeguarding and child safety.

EAC's Statement of Diversity and Inclusion

EAC embodies inclusion and diversity. As a community, we embrace the truth that diversity enriches us as individuals and as a community. Diversity includes recognizing individual differences in relation to cultural backgrounds, age, abilities, religious beliefs, gender and gender expression, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, religious beliefs, political beliefs, or other ideologies. The multiplicity of backgrounds and perspectives within our community reflect the entire world. Thus, we work to ensure that all members of our community enjoy mutual respect, are valued for who they are, and share a sense of belonging.

title: Collections Analyst
description:
About Credix

Credix is a FinTech company dedicated to growing businesses in Latin America. Building on our expertise, we now focus on providing a tailored Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) solution for B2B transactions in Brazil with our platform, CrediPay. CrediPay is created to help business grow their sales and improve their cashflow efficiency through seamless and risk-free credit offering. Sellers offer their buyers flexible payment terms at an attractive price point and receive upfront payments. We manage and protect our clients from any credit & fraud risk, letting them focus only on what matters: increased sales and profitability.

Why choose Credix?

  • Become part of a forward-thinking start-up where boldness and a commitment to excellence are paramount, and your personal and professional development is at the forefront.
  • Work alongside a dedicated team of bright individuals driven by an Olympian mindset to excel in every aspect of our operations. Together, we aim to build with velocity, utilizing innovative embedded finance strategies to expand business operations in Latin America.
  • Experience a close and supportive work atmosphere where collaboration thrives, wise judgment guides our decisions, and you can learn, grow, and take on meaningful responsibilities.

About the Job

We're building Brazil's largest B2B credit infrastructure, and we're looking for a Collections Analyst who is a true negotiation master to play a key role in that journey. You'll be on the front line of debt recovery, negotiating directly — and skillfully — with a wide range of profiles, from small business owners to C-Level executives at global companies, always finding the angle that gets deals done while building the kind of trust that strengthens Credix's relationships with its clients. But this role goes beyond collecting: you'll think strategically, analyzing delinquency data, surfacing actionable insights, and helping shape the future of our automation-first collections model. If you're a natural dealmaker, a decisive owner, a clear communicator, and thrive in a dynamic credit landscape, this is the role for you.

Qualifications

  • 1–2 year of experience in collections, accounts receivable, customer service, call centers, or operational roles.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English.
  • Manage a portfolio of customers, monitoring payments and driving collection negotiations with the skill of a true dealmaker — efficient, respectful, and always finding a path to resolution.
  • Monitor and control accounts receivable, ensuring financial records are accurate, organized, and up to date.
  • Use Excel and SQL to analyze data, track key performance indicators, and manage the collections portfolio. Support the automation of operational processes using Python (preferred) to improve efficiency and streamline workflows.
  • Investigate and resolve payment discrepancies, providing timely and effective solutions.
  • Prioritize competing demands and manage multiple tasks while maintaining a high level of organization and attention to detail.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure an excellent customer experience and drive operational efficiency.

Responsibilities

  • Own an assigned client wallet, negotiating like a true master dealmaker over phone and messaging and recovering outstanding debts across varied customer profiles — from small business owners to C-Level executives at global companies.
  • Take ownership of decisions and proactively align with cross-functional teams to solve collection challenges.
  • Prepare daily and weekly reports on recovery rates, DPD trends, and case resolutions.
  • Analyze delinquency data to generate actionable insights that improve collection strategies.
  • Automate repetitive tasks and use tools like Python and SQL to build scripts that improve process efficiency.
  • Identify inefficiencies and implement automated workflows to streamline collections processes.
  • Conduct quality audits of external collection agencies, providing feedback to improve recovery rates.
  • Track performance against KPIs, including recoveries per OKR/Collections Policy and percentage of automated workflows implemented.

What We Offer

Collaboration and team spirit thrive best in an in-office environment. Our São Paulo office provides a vibrant and engaging workspace where team members can connect, learn, and grow together.

In addition, we offer:

  • A culture of learning and experimentation, where curiosity is encouraged.
  • Competitive salary package.
  • Equity stock options plan.
  • Paid holidays.
  • Clear growth opportunities within collections and operations.
  • Team off-sites focused on collaboration, fun, and shared experiences.

Empresa confidencial

Sua missão será garantir a solidez financeira e a sustentabilidade do negócio por meio da gestão estratégica das áreas de Controladoria, Tesouraria, Contas a Pagar, Contas a Receber e Compras. Quais serão as suas atribuições?

  • Coordenar as áreas de Controladoria, Tesouraria, Contas a Pagar, Contas a Receber e Compras, garantindo eficiência operacional e conformidade dos processos;
  • Supervisionar os processos de fechamento contábil e financeiro, assegurando a confiabilidade das informações e o cumprimento das normas contábeis e regulatórias;
  • Elaborar, analisar e apresentar relatórios gerenciais e indicadores financeiros, incluindo Balanço Patrimonial, DRE, DFC, fluxo de caixa direto e indireto;
  • Planejar, acompanhar e controlar o orçamento corporativo, monitorando desvios e propondo ações corretivas;
  • Consolidar resultados financeiros e preparar apresentações executivas para a diretoria;
  • Desenvolver e acompanhar indicadores financeiros (KPIs), apoiando a tomada de decisão estratégica;
  • Liderar, desenvolver e engajar a equipe financeira, promovendo capacitação, acompanhamento de desempenho e evolução contínua;
  • Implementar melhorias em processos, controles internos e sistemas financeiros, aumentando eficiência, automação e escalabilidade da área;
  • Desenvolver políticas, normas e procedimentos internos, fortalecendo a governança corporativa e o compliance financeiro;
  • Atuar de forma próxima às demais áreas da empresa, garantindo alinhamento entre estratégia, operação e resultados financeiros.

Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Experiência sólida em gestão financeira, controladoria e tesouraria;
  • Vivência na coordenação de equipes financeiras multidisciplinares;
  • Experiência na elaboração e análise de demonstrações financeiras e gerenciais (Balanço Patrimonial, DRE, DFC e fluxo de caixa);
  • Conhecimento em planejamento financeiro, orçamento empresarial e acompanhamento de indicadores de performance (KPIs);
  • Experiência com gestão de Contas a Pagar, Contas a Receber e processos de Compras;
  • Domínio de processos de fechamento contábil e controles financeiros;
  • Conhecimento sólido em sistemas ERP;
  • Perfil analítico, organizado, colaborativo e orientado à melhoria contínua;
  • Excelente comunicação, capacidade de liderança e habilidade para apoiar decisões estratégicas da empresa.

Você pode se destacar se:

  • Tiver experiência em empresas de tecnologia ou consultorias;
  • Possuir vivência com automação e otimização de processos financeiros;
  • Conhecer o ERP Sankhya;

title: Compliance Analyst (Compliance Testing)
description:
Compliance Analyst (Compliance Testing)

Location: Brazil

Language Requirement: Advanced English (must be able to participate in meetings, discussions, and professional conversations in English)

Education: Bachelor's Degree completed in Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field.

About the Role

We are looking for a Compliance Analyst to join the ATE Compliance Program, working closely with the Compliance Program Lead. In this role, you will help ensure that technology and process controls meet internal compliance requirements and regulatory standards.

The ideal candidate will have experience with compliance testing, audit support, control validation, and risk management processes, along with strong communication skills to collaborate with global teams and auditors.

Key Responsibilities

Compliance Program Support

  • Understand compliance requirements, policies, and standards, ensuring teams adhere to established controls and procedures.
  • Test and validate controls to confirm they are properly designed and operating effectively.
  • Review compliance evidence and supporting documentation.
  • Support internal and external audits by collecting, validating, and providing required evidence.
  • Respond to compliance-related inquiries and assist in resolving issues, findings, and escalations.
  • Participate in discussions regarding control design, process improvements, and compliance best practices.
  • Help maintain audit readiness across supported teams and processes.

Compliance Areas Supported

  • IT General Controls (ITGC)
  • Information Security Policies (ISP)
  • Quality Management System (QMS)

Quality Management System (QMS)

  • Support Global and Territory-specific QMS testing activities.
  • Assist with evidence collection, validation, and audit support throughout the year.
  • Ensure QMS controls are consistently followed, documented, and maintained.
  • Monitor compliance with QMS requirements and identify opportunities for improvement.

Stakeholder Management

You will work closely with:

  • IT Product Teams
  • Engineering Teams
  • Security and Risk Management Teams
  • QMS Control Owners
  • Internal Auditors
  • External Auditors

As a trusted compliance partner, you will serve as a key resource for compliance-related guidance, helping teams remain compliant and audit-ready at all times.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree completed in Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Advanced English, including the ability to communicate effectively in meetings and professional discussions.
  • Experience with compliance, audit, risk, governance, or control-testing activities.
  • Knowledge of IT General Controls (ITGC).
  • Familiarity with Information Security controls and policies.
  • Experience reviewing documentation, evidence, and compliance records.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work with cross-functional teams.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting Quality Management Systems (QMS).
  • Experience working with internal and external auditors.
  • Knowledge of compliance frameworks, governance processes, and risk management practices.
  • Experience in global or multinational environments.
  • Familiarity with technology, software development, or IT operations processes.

What You Can Expect From Us

  • Continuous professional development aligned with your career goals.
  • Opportunities for international experience and exposure to global projects.
  • A collaborative, diverse, and innovative work environment.
  • Mentorship and career growth opportunities.

Benefits

  • Health Insurance
  • Dental Plan
  • Life Insurance
  • Transportation Allowance
  • Meal/Food Allowance
  • Childcare Assistance
  • TotalPass
  • 24/7 Employee Assistance Program (psychological, legal, and financial support)
  • Certification Reimbursement
  • Learning Platform with free training and courses
  • Employee Referral Bonus Program
  • Recognition Program
  • Mentorship and Career Development Platform
